HomePage.title: ERASMUS+ PROGRAMME
HomePage.desc: Study or train abroad through the Erasmus+ programme at Kielce University of Technology — for incoming and outgoing students, staff, and partner institutions.
HomePage.ans: Every mobility builds skills, confidence, and a stronger CV.
HomePage.testimonials-desc: Hear directly from students who studied or trained abroad through Erasmus+ — their experiences, friendships, and the skills they gained.
HomePage.get-desc: Everything you need to plan your Erasmus+ mobility.

partner.title: KA-131 · PROGRAMME COUNTRIES
partner.desc: KUT's bilateral agreements across Europe, organised by country. Names are not sorted alphabetically or by country group — use your browser's find function (Ctrl+F).
partner.not-listed: If you'd like to go to a university not on this list
partner.step-3: We will contact the chosen university.
partner.check: Check that the university has an agreement for the ISCED-F code matching your field of study, then look for the exchange offer on their website or contact their international office directly. Fill in the application form and follow the steps in Outgoing students → Studies/Internship.
